notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, census arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + concept-census evidence (which concepts and domains selected the pole)); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strongest examples are the space or ';' separating journal/year from volume in reference lists, with ' for' after a noun as a second regime; the census food hit looks like the ' for' purpose reading (sugar for topping). Mixed pole, so low confidence; quiet items avoid ' for' and citations, though harder edges would be better.
